models.title: Estimated total depreciable asset life
models.summary: Historical cost divided by annual depreciation estimates the total useful life.

relationship.original_equation: Estimated total life = historical cost / annual depreciation expense
relationship.translation_notes: The output is a dimensionless count of annual financial periods, not physical seconds.

assumptions: The ratio uses a consistent historical-cost asset pool and annual accounting period.
The single-asset interpretation assumes straight-line depreciation, stable estimates and zero residual value.
limitations: Asset mixes, revaluations, impairments, retirements and fully depreciated assets make this only a rough proxy.
Nonzero residual value makes gross historical cost divided by annual depreciation exceed the simple useful-life estimate.
